test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'destroyed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage indicates a grave danger to the environment. "Destroyed" is the most suitable word to define this severity.
 
• The word "destroyed" implies something being damaged so badly that it can't be repaired, which fits within the grave warning about the environment in the passage.
 
• It also suggests the damage being done is irreversible and it can't be undone once it's complete.
 
• The implication that mankind is responsible for such a destructive outcome gives a lot more weight and warns us of the serious implications of our actions on the environment.

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Tried', 'spoiled', and 'tampered' imply some level of change or harm, but not to the same devastating extent as 'destroyed'.
 
• 'Tried' refers to an attempt to do something, 
 
• 'spoiled' means ruined or adversely affected, 
 
• 'tampered' implies unauthorized or improper interference or alteration
